name: Old Japanese
notes: STRUCTURAL ANCESTRY NODE (not a modelled G2P target). Old Japanese (8th c., Nara period) is the earliest attested stage of Japanese and an intermediate node between Proto-Japonic and modern Japanese. It exists so that the ancestry and phylogenetic-distance metrics of the modern varieties that reference it have a node to resolve to. It carries no grapheme table. Old Japanese is written in Chinese characters (man'yōgana); a table needs a cited reconstruction, the romanization it is written in and the sound value of each symbol.
